sources.title: MAGI-2 Preview: Sand.ai's Open-Source 114B Audio-Video Model
sources.snippet: Sand.ai released MAGI-2 Preview on August 5, an open-source, 114B-parameter mixture-of-experts (MoE) model that generates 10-second videos with synchronized audio from a text prompt or a prompt plus a still image.
